modern_value_zh: 非人格化治理的理论框架——从'非人'概念出发理解制度设计的去人性化趋势
跨学派比较方法论——道家、法家、儒家对'非人'概念的多维解读
思维模式系统化提取——从战国思想到现代知识体系的范式转换
modern_value_en: Theoretical framework of non-personalized governance—understanding dehumanization trends in institutional design through the 'non-person' concept
Cross-school comparative methodology—multi-dimensional interpretations of 'non-person' from Daoist, Legalist, and Confucian perspectives
Systematic extraction of thinking modes—paradigm shift from Warring States thought to modern knowledge systems

modern_value_zh: 存在论奠基——「存在与本质区分」是本体论作为独立学科的理论起点
实验方法先驱——药物检验七则是对照实验与因果推断的历史源头
知识体系构建范本——百科体系综合法是跨学科知识组织的经典方法
modern_value_en: Foundation of ontology—the essence-existence distinction as the theoretical origin of ontology as a discipline
Pioneer of experimental method—the seven rules as the historical source of controlled experimentation and causal inference
Model of knowledge system building—encyclopedic synthesis as the classic method of interdisciplinary organization

modern_value_zh: 权威整合方法论——「真理不相冲突」是跨范式对话与知识体系整合的经典框架
科学思维奠基——因果必然论为自然规律与可预测性提供形而上学前提
传播分层范式——三级论证与三级评注是受众分层与知识分辨率设计的原型
modern_value_en: Authority integration—truth-does-not-oppose-truth as a classic framework for cross-paradigm dialogue
Foundation of scientific thinking—causal necessity as the metaphysical ground of laws of nature
Communication layering—tripartite argumentation and commentary tiers as prototypes of resolution design

modern_value_zh: 批判程序伦理——先转述后判教与二十题分级裁决是论辩、评审与分歧管理的经典程序框架
认识论自查工具——方法论怀疑与知识体检分域法可直接用于技术选型与学习投资审计
知行转化诊断——动机审计与知行断裂诊断对个人成长、组织培训与变革管理高度可迁移
modern_value_en: Procedural ethics of critique—steel-man-then-adjudicate and graded verdicts as frameworks for review and disagreement management
Epistemic self-audit—methodic doubt and knowledge-domain triage applied directly to tech selection and learning portfolios
Knowledge-action diagnosis—intention audit and rift diagnosis, highly transferable to growth, training, and change management

modern_value_zh: 怀疑—重建工程学：来源审计、我思原点、极限压测构成系统性重建的完整程序，可直接迁移到技术栈重写与危机审计
方法程序化：四规则与普遍数学把'想清楚'变为可执行、可复查的流程，是任务拆解与评测设计的经典框架
表示法革命：坐标代数统一法是跨系统翻译层设计（协议转换、数据整合）的元方法
modern_value_en: Doubt-and-rebuild engineering: source audit, cogito anchor, and extreme stress-testing form a complete rebuild procedure, directly transferable to stack rewrites and crisis audits
Method as program: the four rules and universal math turn 'thinking clearly' into an executable, auditable process—a classic frame for task decomposition and eval design
Representation revolution: the coordinate-algebra method is the meta-method for cross-system translation layers (protocol conversion, data integration)
